mode: read-only source research; documentary utilities only

scope.union_scope: Selected rounds2–8 only, heterogeneous authored groups. Not whole campaign coverage, suite denominator, ports or passes.

grouping_policy: One group per Go character failure predicate, Go string observation/predicate, Zig named test including full helpers, or libc++ assert site. Within-group sites/phase/lexeme dispositions are retained and not counted as extra groups or dynamic executions.
outcome_policy: Expected upstream outcomes inferred from complete source. Go run annotations are read; no errorcheck annotations in selected files. Go ken prints have no in-file output assertion and are labeled observations, not golden checks. Zig expect errors, unreachable/panic/compileError and backend skips retained. libc++ assert outcomes require enabled asserts; C++17 static_assert phase excluded. No actual peer program run.
local_coverage_policy: Source spans/expected output describe related coverage only. No selected upstream group is credited already covered; incompatible semantics never acquire credit because values coincide.

proposed_original_regressions.name: Scalar payload captured before source mutation across continue and break
proposed_original_regressions.proposed_minyar_source:
let source = [1, 2, 3]
let position = 0
let visits = 0
let tail = 0
let captured = 0
for value in source {
    let index = position
    position += 1
    visits += 1
    source[index] += 99
    captured = captured * 10 + value
    value = 900
    if index == 0 { continue }
    if index == 1 { break }
    tail += 1
}
print(captured)
print(visits)
print(position)
print(tail)
for value in source { print(value) }
